Latin word

patior

patior, patī, passus sum

verb, third conjugation (-iō), deponent

let happen, put up with; suffer, undergo, bear

In this lexicon

  • allow

    also used · classical · Gell. 5.2.3: haud umquam īnscendī sēsē ab aliō nisi ab rēge passus sit; Cic. de Or. 1.126: nōn patiēbātur

  • suffer

    the recommended word · classical · Liv. 2.12.9: et facere et patī fortia Rōmānum est; Phaedr. 3.7.11: nunc patior nivēs; Traupman 387
